verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Lord the Light or Your Love is shining
In the midst of the darkness shining

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Jesus light of the
world shine upon us

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Set us free by the truth
You now bring us
Shine on me. Shine on me

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Shine Jesus shine
Fill this land with the Father's glory

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Blaze, Spirit blaze
Set our hearts on fire

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Flow, river flow
Flood the nations with grace and mercy

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Send forth Your word
Lord and let there be light

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: Lord I come to Your awesome presence

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: From the shadows into Your radiance

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines: By the blood I may enter Your brightness,

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
Search me, try me
Consume all my darkness
Shine on me. Shine on me

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines: As we gaze on Your kindly brightness

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines: So our faces display Your likeness

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Ever changing from glory to glory
Mirrored here may our lives tell Your story.

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines: Shine on me. Shine on me
